interpretation: This measures control-plane admission latency and isolated reputation ranking cost, NOT end-to-end TTFT against a real engine. Before: authorize recomputed supplier reputation with a full execution_contracts aggregate (legacy_reputation_aggregate_ms) inside the buyer funding critical section; that term scaled with history and dominated under concurrency. After: authorize joins realtime_supplier_outcome_stats (stats_table_reputation_read_ms), which does not scale with history. authorize_admission_ms is the full AuthorizeRealtimeContract path after the change. Do not claim the c=32 CUDA deficit is closed — that needs GPU hardware this machine does not have.

claims.measures: control-plane admission latency (AuthorizeRealtimeContract) and isolated reputation ranking probes
claims.does_not_measure: end-to-end TTFT against a real engine; does not claim the c=32 CUDA deficit is closed
claims.evidence: At ~100k execution_contracts rows, legacy full aggregate ranking p50 is 110.95ms (c=1) / 1126ms (c=32); stats-table ranking p50 is 0.17ms (c=1) / 0.85ms (c=32). Full authorize after the change stays ~1.8ms at c=1 and ~42ms at c=32 (buyer funding advisory lock serializes same-buyer concurrent admits).
